recordFields.name: item or currency name
recordFields.base: base type, when different from the name
recordFields.variant: variant, for uniques that have them
recordFields.divine: value in divine orbs, when provided
recordFields.listings: number of listings behind the price (confidence)
recordFields.id: poe.ninja's own slug for the record
recordFields.link: best-effort link back to the poe.ninja page (advisory)
